Container.Name: jellyglance-db
Container.Overview: PostgreSQL 18 companion for JellyGlance. Install on the same custom Docker network as jellyglance, then set JellyGlance POSTGRES_IP to jellyglance-db with matching credentials.
Container.Description:
Official postgres:18-alpine image, packaged as a one-click companion for JellyGlance.
Put both containers on one custom network. Match POSTGRES_USER / POSTGRES_PASSWORD / POSTGRES_DB with the jellyglance template. Skip this if you already run Postgres elsewhere.
Postgres 18 defaults to PGDATA=/var/lib/postgresql/18/docker. Mount data at /var/lib/postgresql, not the old /var/lib/postgresql/data path. Do not switch an existing volume between major versions by changing the image tag or mount: dump with the old version and restore into a fresh Postgres 18 volume first.

Config.Name: Database Data
Config.Description: Postgres 18 data root (PGDATA=/var/lib/postgresql/18/docker). Use a fresh volume or dump/restore from an older major version.
